title: ImportResult
description: Per-file report of one import batch (spec 8.1, M05): the 'result' of an 'import' job. Every candidate file appears exactly once; failures are never dropped. Items name files only relative to the request root they came from; full paths stay in the job params and are never logged. Consistency between 'totals' and 'items' is checked semantically.

ImportMode.title: ImportMode
ImportMode.description: 'reference' keeps the file where it is; 'managed' copies it into the library's content-addressed storage. Moving is not offered (spec 8.1.3).

ImportRequest.title: ImportRequest
ImportRequest.description: Parameters of an 'import' job. Each path is a file or a folder; folders are scanned for media files ('recursive' includes subfolders). Paths must be absolute (checked by the worker).

recursive.description: Scan subfolders of folder paths. Default false.

source_kind.description: Where the captures come from. Default 'other'.

ImportItem.title: ImportItem
ImportItem.description: Outcome for one file. 'imported', 'existing' (same bytes already in the library), and 'relinked' (a missing asset found again) carry 'asset_id'; 'skipped' (not attempted: not a media file, or a link leaving the selected folder) and 'failed' carry 'error'.

relative_path.description: For files found in a folder: '/'-separated path relative to that folder. Absent when the request path was the file itself.

candidate_asset_ids.description: Other assets that look like the same content (perceptual duplicate candidates, 1.4). Reported for review only; nothing is merged.

RelinkRequest.title: RelinkRequest
RelinkRequest.description: Parameters of a 'relink' job: point a referenced asset at a file in a new location. The file must be verified as the same content before the link changes.

RelinkResult.title: RelinkResult
RelinkResult.description: Result of a 'relink' job. 'verified_by' names the identity check that matched; M05 compares size and the full SHA-256.

SourceCheckResult.title: SourceCheckResult
SourceCheckResult.description: Result of a 'check_sources' job: which assets' original (reference) or library copy (managed) can no longer be found.

restored.description: Assets marked missing before that were found again.

missing_asset_ids.description: Up to 1000 missing assets, oldest first.
